title: Shared periodic function decoder with Mirror amplitude/phase/frequency code
hypothesis: Small amplitude/phase/frequency views recover held-out periodic functions with fewer actual bytes than independent sampled curves; Mirror-specific value must beat native periodic activation modulation.
fit_policy: Infer frequency by minimum support residual over the four frozen harmonics; solve sine/cosine coefficients by least squares. No audit data enter fitting.
storage: Actual serialized inference .npz bytes, including shared decoder schema, per-signal codes or sampled curves, indices and metadata.
compute: Count support-frequency candidates, least-squares operations, decoder arithmetic operations and isolated wall time; zero optimizer updates.
success_gate: Both development seeds: held-out audit nRMSE <=1e-5 and Mirror payload <=25% independent curve payload. Mirror-specific success further requires better bytes or compute than native activation modulation at equal quality.
failure_gate: Quality/storage gate miss or native activation modulation exact/equal-cost alias. Fresh remains sealed after any failure.
